purpose: 可复用的客户经营 Bot：把 {{business_name}} 的新客按阶段推进，触达受静默时段与频次上限约束，无响应按期升级给 {{owner_name}}。

zh.first_touch: {{business_name}}：给您留了一份{{entry_stage}}专属说明，需要我发您吗？
zh.follow_up: 上次给您留的资料还在，要不要我用 2 分钟陪您走一遍？
zh.escalation: 这条客户已 {{escalation_days}} 天无响应，转人工跟进。

en.first_touch: {{business_name}}: I saved a short guide for new {{entry_stage}} guests. Shall I send it?
en.follow_up: I kept that starter guide for you - want me to walk you through it in 2 minutes?
en.escalation: No reply for {{escalation_days}} days; handing over to a human.
en.opt_out_ack: Noted - you will not be contacted again.

playbook.goal: 确认身份与需求，不推销
给一次明确的小动作（发资料/约体验）
换角度复述价值，不复读原文

guardrails.opt_out: 客户回复 {{opt_out_keyword}} 立即永久停止
